LESSON: SIGN READING 8.4.1 POETRY: CHARACTERS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.4: Sign Reading 8.4.1 Poetry: Characters
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 8.4.1 Poetry: Characters, part of Strand 8 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How do we tell the behaviour of the characters in a poem?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 8.4.1 Poetry: Characters together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

Creativity and Imagination: Learner develop creativity as he/she creates, recites, records and uploads a poem on social media

platforms.

Values:
Unity: the learners work in pairs or groups to describe character traits.

Link to other subjects

Languages such as Kiswahili and Kenya Sign Language use adjectives when highlighting character traits.
